answer: Sponsored admission plus reputation decay stops fake identities: a newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 50 units, forfeited if the newcomer cheats. Each dawn, reputation decays 2%, so an idle identity goes hollow within 50 days and must earn honest work to stay valid. A falcon hunts one prey at a time: each sponsor backs at most 5 newcomers, so 1,000 fakes need 200 sponsors and 50,000 units locked, while honest agents pay once.
